posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-market 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-815016b886738d6a0c65.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-market is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-815016b886738d6a0c65.html
